title: The School Uniform Debate
text:
Many schools argue that uniforms reduce social pressure, because students cannot compete through expensive clothes. Supporters believe that a shared dress code creates a sense of belonging and makes mornings simpler for families.

Critics, however, claim that uniforms limit self-expression and do little to address the real causes of bullying. In their view, schools should focus on respectful behaviour rather than on what students wear.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why do supporters say uniforms reduce social pressure?
options: Because uniforms are cheaper to make
Because students cannot compete through expensive clothes

questions.text: What do critics say schools should focus on, according to paragraph two?
What can the reader infer about the critics' view of uniforms?
options: They believe uniforms may not address the root causes of bullying
They think uniforms are too expensive for all families
They want schools to ban all dress codes
They believe uniforms make mornings longer

questions.text: Why might a family find a school uniform helpful, based on paragraph one?
options: Children stop wanting to go to school
Mornings become simpler because there are fewer clothing choices

paragraph_translations: Birçok okul, üniformanın sosyal baskıyı azalttığını savunur, çünkü öğrenciler pahalı kıyafetlerle yarışamaz. Destekçiler, ortak bir kıyafet kurallarının aidiyet duygusu yarattığına ve ailelerin sabahlarını kolaylaştırdığına inanır.

Ancak eleştirmenler, üniformaların kendini ifade etmeyi sınırladığını ve zorbalığın gerçek nedenlerini çözmede pek etkili olmadığını öne sürer. Onlara göre okullar, öğrencilerin ne giydiğinden çok saygılı davranışlara odaklanmalıdır.
